# algolia_recommend_rule (Data Source)

Use this data source to read an Algolia Recommend rule for a specific index and model.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algolia_index" "example" {
  name                = "products"
  deletion_protection = false
}

resource "algolia_recommend_rule" "hide_discontinued" {
  index_name = algolia_index.example.name
  model      = "related-products"
  object_id  = "hide-discontinued"

  consequence = jsonencode({
    hide = [
      { objectID = "42" },
    ]
  })
}

data "algolia_recommend_rule" "example" {
  index_name = algolia_recommend_rule.hide_discontinued.index_name
  model      = algolia_recommend_rule.hide_discontinued.model
  object_id  = algolia_recommend_rule.hide_discontinued.object_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `index_name` (String) The index the Recommend rule applies to.
- `model` (String) Recommend model the rule applies to.
- `object_id` (String) Unique identifier of the Recommend rule.

### Read-Only

- `condition` (String) JSON-encoded condition that triggers the rule (`context`/`filters`).
- `consequence` (String) JSON-encoded effect of the rule (`hide`/`promote`/`params`).
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the rule's purpose.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active.
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier in the form <index_name>/<model>/<object_id>.
- `validity` (String) JSON-encoded array of time periods during which the rule is active.
